title: Apple is adding an AI chatbot to Pages, Keynote, and Numbers
slides: Apple is adding an AI chatbot to its office apps. Why now?
Pages, Keynote, Numbers get Siri-powered writing and editing help.
Unlike rivals, Apple's assistant keeps your data on-device.
You'll draft slides and reports by chatting, not clicking.
Try one real document today: let the assistant edit it.
thread_text:
1. Apple's Quiet AI Move

Apple is adding an AI chatbot to Pages, Keynote, and Numbers. The company that rarely ships unfinished features is now betting on writing and editing help inside its office apps.

2. Why the Sudden Shift?

Microsoft and Google already have AI everywhere. Apple waited, and now it's entering through the apps you use to draft reports and slides, not a separate chat window.

3. Your Data Stays Put

Apple says Siri handles the editing on-device. Competitors send your prompts to the cloud. That privacy difference could be the reason to switch or stay.

4. Chat, Don't Click

Instead of hunting for formatting buttons, you describe what you want. The assistant drafts slides and reports from conversation, which changes how you think about document creation.

5. Test It on One File

Open a real document today and ask the assistant to edit one paragraph. If the output needs heavy rewrites, the on-device trade-off may not be worth it yet.

Pages, Keynote and Numbers are getting a built-in chatbot that writes and edits for you 🍎

Apple is adding Siri-powered writing and editing help directly inside its office apps.

Unlike Microsoft and Google, Apple says the editing runs on-device, so your prompts stay off the cloud.

You describe what you want in chat instead of clicking through formatting menus ✍️

If you draft reports or slides for a living, this changes your daily workflow: less time hunting for buttons, more time directing the assistant.

Apple waited while rivals shipped AI everywhere — now it's betting on privacy as the differentiator 🔒

Would you trust an on-device assistant to edit a client document, or would you double-check every line? 🤔
